title: Evaluate 110% swipe sensitivity during the next real shopping trip
source: After successful Monday shopping, swipe sensitivity may feel too low. User requests another shop run at 110% before changing defaults.
expected: Record deliberate activation effort and accidental actions during the next physical trip at 110%, then decide whether a default change is justified.
implementation: No default, gravity, velocity or distance-trigger changes authorized by this report. The user can select the existing 110% setting.
